title: Deterministic and Nondeterministic Step Agreement
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, alphabet $\Sigma$, and state set $Q$; let $O$ be a language over $\Sigma$, let $b\in\{0,1\}$, and let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$ with $k+1$ work tapes. The step of the nondeterministic machine obtained from $M$, using choice bit $b$ and oracle $O$, produces exactly the same configuration as one step of $M$ relative to $O$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
$\Sigma$ is the symbol alphabet and $Q$ is the state set
$x$ is the fixed input and $c$ is a configuration on $x$ with $k+1$ work tapes
